# Supersedes the 2026-08-10 Phase 1 gate version, which predated Phases 2-6.
# Re-verified 2026-08-11 at HEAD c7d606d3 (post-adjudication re-run, after
# 78399db0 "fix(nsclc): value_code stage observation ends String-vs-Code collision"
# and c7d606d3 "fix(alzheimers): hospice election rates for combined stock+fork
# target"): the touched-module file list is unchanged (same 47 surviving files of
# 48 touched since feffd500) and the extracted code set is byte-identical (150
# codes) -- 78399db0 only rewrote Observation-type states (Stage_Observation_I-IV),
# not ConditionOnset states, and c7d606d3 only edited probability/rate values, not
# codes.
# Command used to derive the module list:
#   git diff --name-only feffd500..HEAD -- src/main/resources/modules/
# One file from that diff, b_cell_lymphomas.json, was retired (commit 61ed01ac,
# "retire b_cell_lymphomas in favor of dlbcl/mantle_cell_lymphoma") and does not
# survive on the current branch tip, so it contributes no codes.
# For each surviving .json in that list, every ConditionOnset state codes[].code
# was extracted (sorted, deduplicated). Regenerate by re-running that diff against
# the current branch tip and re-extracting; the file is not auto-generated at gate time.
# 150 unique codes from 47 surviving fork modules (of 48 files touched since feffd500).
